title: Resistance at fixed current
hook: Change resistance and predict resistor power.
misconception: resistor power stays fixed when resistance doubles.
objective: Apply P = I²R to compare resistor power when resistance changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With an ohmic resistor with fixed current magnitude, P = I²R. When resistance doubles, resistor power becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model P = I²R; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider an ohmic resistor with fixed current magnitude, with a nonzero initial result. If resistance triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on resistor power?
recall.why: Apply P = I²R under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
